reasons.message: Auto-merge is opt-in and not enabled for risk class "medium" in autopilot.yaml; the task can still complete via human review (run `maestro handoff emit`, or set autoMergeAllowed.medium: true — note: enabling auto-merge is a "loosening" and soaks for 30 days before taking effect; run `maestro policy pending` to see in-flight changes).
